title: Q(n) scaling of the toolbox route on a new synthetic family
question: On an out-of-registry delayed-coupling family, does the toolbox's fit-and-report (frozen lag-window provider + closed-form intercept ridge) keep improving on held-out rows as train n grows, or plateau?

interpretation_registered_before_running.S1_fail: route is nondeterministic — void the route fields
interpretation_registered_before_running.S2_fail: the fit-and-report ladder is non-monotone — the scaling story is not simple; report per-cell
interpretation_registered_before_running.S3_pass: R2(25000) - R2(200) >= 0.10 — the frozen path keeps scaling on this family
interpretation_registered_before_running.S3_fail: the frozen path plateaus on this family — L1 evidence (growth must change codes, not heads)
interpretation_registered_before_running.plateau: the first n at which the ladder is within 0.01 of the top cell is reported, not hidden

model.note: one self-consistent in-process encoder (the M172b pattern)
